race.comment: JAZ TYCOON (1) showed little early speed last start and failed to come on in the straight when seventh, beaten 6 lengths, over 1600m at Seymour. Finds a nice race and can take this out. TREASURY PLACE (4) hit the frame two starts ago at Warrnambool but ran below par last time when ninth and beaten 14 lengths over 1700m at Warrnambool. Perfectly placed and is sure to play a pivotal role. MR GEORGE (5) showed the benefit of earlier runs in the campaign with minor placings at his past two and he's drawn to maintain the good form. BLACKHILL BOY (2) finished 1.4 lengths away in fifth last time out over 1600m at Tatura two-and-a-half weeks ago. Tackles a longer journey this time. Solid winning chance. HASTA LA SILVER (3) has improved at every start and might have more upside than most, so can go on with it.
